indications: Weakness or pain in the affected leg
Reduced weight bearing on a lower limb
measurement: Ships in 1 adult size that fits most users. The shaft adjusts from 29 to 38 in. Measure from the floor to the crease of the wrist while standing upright in everyday shoes, then set the cane to that height. Choose the lower setting if the user falls between 2 settings. Wear the shoes you use most often when you measure. Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides, not shrugged. Have a helper read the measurement at the wrist crease for accuracy. Recheck the height after any change in footwear. Set and lock the height before the first use. Hold the cane in the hand opposite the weaker or painful leg. Move the cane and the weaker leg forward together, then step through with the stronger leg. Inspect the rubber tip each month and replace it when the tread wears smooth. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
